fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-04-25 states that Mythili Selvi, aged 72, was reported missing after leaving for work; the last sighting was near Sevvanthi Colony Bus Stand Area, on 2025-04-25 around 16:15 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Saranya Murugan (9000000193), a family member of Mythili Selvi, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000244. Amudha Kannan (9000000066) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A further person, Udhay Muthu, an intermediary, using the number 9000000352, is stated to be associated with the incident. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Elderly person reportedly left home alone and did not return.
fields.Keywords: missing person, elderly, associate, CCTV, afternoon, bus stand, witness
